stages.name: a
stages.query: SELECT __path,ast_kind AS kind,ast_name AS name,NULL AS alias,NULL AS module,NULL AS value,NULL AS value_kind,CAST(NULLIF(ast_preorder,'') AS INTEGER) AS id,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS bfs,CAST(NULLIF(ast_parent,'') AS INTEGER) AS parent,ast_field AS field,CAST(NULLIF(ast_index,'') AS INTEGER) AS position,CAST(NULLIF(ast_end,'') AS INTEGER) AS last,CAST(NULLIF(ast_function,'') AS INTEGER) AS fn,NULL AS op,CAST(NULLIF(ast_start,'') AS INTEGER) AS __start,CAST(NULLIF(ast_stop,'') AS INTEGER) AS __end,CAST(NULLIF(ast_line,'') AS INTEGER) AS line,NULL AS context,ast_name_repr AS name_repr,NULL AS value_repr,NULL AS annotation,NULL AS annotation_repr FROM canonical

stages.name: calls
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.name AS callee,f.id AS callee_id,r.id AS receiver,r.kind AS receiver_kind,r.name AS receiver_name
      FROM a c JOIN a f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.parent=c.id AND f.field='func'
      LEFT JOIN a r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.parent=f.id AND r.field='value'
      WHERE c.kind='Call'

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM a WHERE kind IN ('FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef')

stages.name: methods
stages.query: SELECT f.*,c.name AS class_name FROM functions f JOIN a c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.id=f.parent AND c.kind='ClassDef' WHERE f.field='body'

stages.name: top
stages.query: SELECT * FROM a WHERE parent=0 AND kind IN ('ClassDef','FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef')

stages.name: last_classes
stages.query: SELECT c.*,CASE WHEN (SELECT name FROM structural_entry)='_lifecycle_violations' THEN c.id ELSE (SELECT min(x.id) FROM top x WHERE x.__path=c.__path AND x.kind='ClassDef' AND x.name=c.name) END AS class_order FROM top c WHERE c.kind='ClassDef' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM top x WHERE x.__path=c.__path AND x.kind='ClassDef' AND x.name=c.name AND CASE WHEN (SELECT name FROM structural_entry) IN ('_connection_file_violations','_sql_connection_violations') THEN x.id<c.id WHEN (SELECT name FROM structural_entry)='_lifecycle_violations' THEN 0 ELSE x.id>c.id END)

stages.name: all_bases
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id,b.name,b.position FROM last_classes c JOIN a b ON b.__path=c.__path AND b.parent=c.id AND b.field='bases'

stages.name: bases
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id,b.name,b.position FROM last_classes c JOIN a b ON b.__path=c.__path AND b.parent=c.id AND b.field='bases' WHERE b.kind IN ('Name','Attribute')

stages.name: struct_methods
stages.query: SELECT m.*,c.class_order FROM last_classes c JOIN methods m ON m.__path=c.__path AND m.parent=c.id

stages.name: self_connect
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT m.__path,m.id FROM struct_methods m JOIN calls c ON c.__path=m.__path AND c.id BETWEEN m.id AND m.last WHERE c.callee_kind='Attribute' AND c.callee IN ('connect','connect_async') AND c.receiver_kind='Name' AND c.receiver_name='self'

stages.name: sync_targets
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE targets(__path,method,id) AS (
 SELECT m.__path,m.id,t.id FROM struct_methods m JOIN a n ON n.__path=m.__path AND n.id BETWEEN m.id AND m.last AND n.kind IN ('Assign','AnnAssign','AugAssign') JOIN a t ON t.__path=n.__path AND t.parent=n.id AND t.field IN ('target','targets')
 UNION ALL SELECT t.__path,t.method,n.id FROM targets t JOIN a p ON p.__path=t.__path AND p.id=t.id AND p.kind IN ('Tuple','List') JOIN a n ON n.__path=p.__path AND n.parent=p.id AND n.field='elts')
 SELECT DISTINCT t.__path,t.method,n.name FROM targets t JOIN a n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.id=t.id JOIN a v ON v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id AND v.field='value' WHERE n.kind='Attribute' AND v.kind='Name' AND v.name='self' AND n.name IN ('_conn','_cursor','_introspector','_validator')

stages.name: line_metrics
stages.query: SELECT l.__path,coalesce(json_extract(p.data,'$.lineCounts.'||json_quote(l.__path)),CAST(l.source_lines AS INTEGER)) source_lines FROM lines l CROSS JOIN structural_configuration p

stages.name: bad_bases
stages.query: SELECT __path,id,group_concat(name,', ') names FROM (SELECT * FROM bases WHERE name NOT IN ('ConnectionPayloadOpaqueMarker','_ConnectionStateCore','_LazyConnectionBase') ORDER BY name) GROUP BY __path,id

stages.name: target_names
stages.query: SELECT __path,method,group_concat(name,', ') AS names FROM (SELECT * FROM sync_targets ORDER BY name) GROUP BY __path,method
